name: hilbert_core
function: antisymmetric Hilbert FIR + aligned I path; envelope, instantaneous phase (brads) and frequency (wrapped first difference)
coefficient_format: signed18 Q15, PAIRS antisymmetric pair coefficients
output_word: m_tdata[79:0] = {freq_s16, phase_u16_brads, env_u16, q_s16, i_s16}; m_tuser = {zero, clip}
envelope: CORDIC x-path 16 iters, ENV_C=19898/2^19; rel err <=0.04% mag>2000
phase: first-octant divide (17 steps) + atan LUT 257 entries + interp; max err ~1.05 brads mag>=32
freq_unwrap: freq = signed16 wrap of brad phase difference (smallest signed step); 0 after clear and on zero
config: atomic after pipeline empty; cfg_pairs 1..PAIRS + packed coeffs + retain/clear; illegal pairs -> cfg_error
remaining: II=1 parallel-FIR variant would exceed the 4-DSP budget; serial MAC schedule is the qualified configuration
